name: pixel2motion
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：pixel2motion。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Turn a raster logo (PNG/JPG/WebP/screenshot) into a clean minimal SVG with edge smoothness as the primary hard gate and IoU optimized as high as reasonably possible without a fixed global threshold, then into a choreographed logo animation delivered as standalone JS-rendered HTML, applying Disney's 12 animation principles. Use when asked to animate a logo, build a logo reveal / splash screen / bra
